test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Diameter of wheel of a cycle is 7 cm. A cyclist takes 75 minutes to reach a destination at the speed of 36.3 km/hr. How many revolutions will the wheel make during the journey?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the total number of revolutions be n.

Total distance covered in 1 revolution or circumference of the wheel

⇒ 2πr = πd = (22/7) × (7/100) = 0.22 m

Total distance covered in journey = (Speed) × (Time)

⇒ 36.3 × (75/60) = 45.375
